reason: I already take magnesium at night at home and I reorder my usual brand when it runs out. I don't need it in a sachet to go, and I'm not switching something that already works for me.
objection: I have a bottle on my nightstand already. Paying more per day for a travel pack I'd never use doesn't make sense.
would_change_my_mind: If my usual brand ran out of stock or jumped in price, and this one was clearly cheaper per day for the same dose.
